purpose: Replace uniform sliding-window averaging with a fixed center-weighted blend to address verified stride-aligned prediction seams without retraining.

change_scope.training: unchanged; use the exact accepted V3 checkpoints

blend.name: separable_raised_cosine_positive_floor
blend.normalization: divide accumulated weighted probabilities by accumulated weights at each covered pixel
blend.boundary_handling: all role-contained windows retained; positive floor guarantees nonzero support at geographic role edges
blend.selection_basis: fixed from window geometry and the V3 stride-artifact diagnosis; no V4 test labels or V4 test metrics used

preflight.cells: seed 0 for every six deep models and four folds; 24 validation-only cells

formal_matrix.deep: rerun validation and test inference for all 6 models x 4 folds x 4 seeds from accepted V3 checkpoints
formal_matrix.random_forest: reuse the exact 32 accepted V3 validation/test probability arrays because RF has no sliding-window inference

evaluation.seed_ensemble: arithmetic mean of four seed probability maps within each model and fold
evaluation.primary_summary: equal-weight mean and sample standard deviation of four fold-level seed-ensemble AP values
evaluation.required_comparison: report V4 minus V3 metric changes and whether the scientific conclusion changes

scientific_boundaries: Scores rank proximity to QFFD traces coded as Inferred under a proxy label.
Outputs are not calibrated geological fault probabilities.
No concealed-fault discovery claim is permitted.
A higher mean AP does not establish stable architecture superiority without consistent fold-level differences.
